why: The search is open. No major reviewer or authority shows up in the results. The pages that answer the question are all small niche sites (testedwatts, homepowerfacts, lightsonlab), and each gives an estimate worked out from specs, about 0.5 h or 35 minutes. testedwatts says outright that it doesn't lab-test. powerstationmatch covers what size inverter you need, but the part with the 1,000 Wh runtime was cut off. Seven of the 12 results had no text. The question is crowded with near-identical calculator pages, so a new page that only repeats the math won't stand out. To become the page ChatGPT relies on, it needs things nobody else has: measured runtimes for named 1,000 Wh models, clear inverter-limit checks, low vs high settings, and a direct pick.
